title: Every role in ROLES-CATALOG has corresponding RLS policy references
description: Role-permission integrity — every role declared in .planning/architecture/ROLES-CATALOG.md (15+ default roles per F2 roles-engine scope) has ≥1 RLS policy entry referencing it in pg_policies.qual or pg_policies.with_check; conversely every role referenced by a pg_policy is declared in ROLES-CATALOG.md (no orphan policy roles). Defense-in-depth for SOC2 CC6.1 + PI1.1 composite (role completeness + policy coverage). When introspection surface unavailable (current state on main HEAD), the rule SKIPs cleanly. F2 (Roles Engine) introduces a canonical role_definitions table; at that point the walker reads from the table instead of parsing ROLES-CATALOG.md markdown.
source: F1-Wave-B Plan B-1b nwrp152 + nwrp153 Q9 D
SOC2 CC6.1 + PI1.1 — role completeness + processing integrity
